title: Dawn® and Cascade® Team Up with Ann Michael Maye to Make Game Day Cleanup Fast and Easy and Give Fans a Chance to Score a Trip to Super Bowl LXI
summary: Dawn® and Cascade® Team Up with Ann Michael Maye to Make Game Day Cleanup Fast and Easy and Give Fans a Chance to Score a Trip to Super Bowl LXI
body_markdown:
*From saucy game-day spreads to messy holiday baking, Maye shows fans how to embrace the foods they love without letting the dread of the cleanup get in the way of the moments that matter.*


CINCINNATI--(BUSINESS WIRE)--As the 2026 NFL season kicks off, Dawn and Cascade, the Official Dish Cleanup Partners of the NFL, are drafting “First Lady of New England” Ann Michael Maye to help fans enjoy all the messy meals, game day spreads and holiday cooking, without dreading the cleanup that follows. From prepping her husband’s favorite lucky pregame snack and watching games at home to baking family recipes for the holidays, Maye will share how she relies on Dawn and Cascade to sideline the mess, so fans don’t have to miss a moment of the game.


As the NFL season and holiday gatherings collide, home gatherings are at an all-time high, and so is the stress at the sink. Data shows that:


- 74% of Americans enjoy watching football at home, while 11% prefer to watch at a friend’s home.*
- 47% of Americans admit that the part they dread most about hosting holiday meals is the staggering mountain of dirty dishes. **


To help fans stay focused on touchdowns rather than dirty dishes, Dawn and Cascade are helping take dish dread off the menu, giving fans a cleanup team they can count on, so they don’t miss a minute of the action.


**Ann Michael Maye Keeps Messes on The Sidelines with Dawn and Cascade**


As an avid baker and wife of the New England Patriots quarterback, Ann Michael Maye knows that some of the best moments of football and the holiday season happen around food. She’ll give fans a peek inside her[game-day traditions](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2F3uMU8HL95s0&esheet=54600557&newsitemid=20260908377815&lan=en-US&anchor=game-day+traditions&index=1&md5=9160f5f8c73a659be82513f136c8bc40) ,[home-field hosting strategies](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2F7b2CjOyuNac&esheet=54600557&newsitemid=20260908377815&lan=en-US&anchor=home-field+hosting+strategies&index=2&md5=2eba6a88fde93b9f2d4a5b308a10e222) , and holiday baking rituals, sharing tips and tricks that help her stay present for it all.


“This is one of my favorite times of year because there are so many reasons to bring everyone together, but from making our favorite pre-game peanut butter energy balls to baking my grandma’s holiday pumpkin bread and trying new recipes, our kitchen gets hit hard,” shares Ann Michael Maye. “I love hosting a full house, but I definitely don’t love the cleanup that comes with it. I put everything I can straight into the dishwasher with Cascade Platinum Plus and rely on Dawn Powerwash for the greasy, sticky hard-to-reach messes like my mixer. They’re two products I know I can count on to get the job done, so I can spend less time worrying about dishes and more time enjoying the food and cheering on the Patriots with family and friends.”


**Score a Trip for Two to Super Bowl LXI with Dawn and Cascade**


Beyond sharing her gameday and holiday hosting playbook, Maye is helping Dawn and Cascade give fans a chance to score an even bigger win this season with a chance for two lucky fans to attend Super Bowl LXI in Inglewood, California.


Grand Prize Details:


- Prize: A four-day, three-night trip for two people to Super Bowl LXI in Los Angeles, California.
- Entry Window: September 1, 2026 (10:00 a.m. ET) – November 15, 2026 (11:59 p.m. ET).


To enter:


1. **Purchase** any Dawn or Cascade product from any retailer during the Sweepstakes Period.
2. **Visit**[DawnandCascade.com/SuperBowlLXI](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdawnandcascade.com%2FSuperbowlLXI%2F&esheet=54600557&newsitemid=20260908377815&lan=en-US&anchor=DawnandCascade.com%2FSuperBowlLXI&index=3&md5=552d3e5d97779da3f44ba5e2ae3db66e) and complete the entry form.
3. **Upload** a photo or screenshot of your eligible receipt.


The Dawn and Cascade Super Bowl LXI Sweepstakes runs from 10:00 a.m. ET on September 1 through 11:59 p.m. ET on November 15, 2026. See the Official Rules, including the no-purchase-necessary method of entry, below and at[DawnandCascade.com/SuperBowlLXI](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdawnandcascade.com%2FSuperbowlLXI%2F&esheet=54600557&newsitemid=20260908377815&lan=en-US&anchor=DawnandCascade.com%2FSuperBowlLXI&index=4&md5=7529ca466b80e34d4b4ad916cdeb4b85) .


**Dawn and Cascade Bring the Cleaning Power**


“For decades, consumers have trusted Dawn and Cascade to take on their toughest kitchen messes, and we're committed to continuing to earn that trust through superior cleaning performance,” said Natalie Dech, Senior Director, North America Dish Care, Procter & Gamble. “Whether it’s game day favorites or holiday meals, we’re putting the brand that consumers know and trust to work. With Dawn and Cascade, they can spend less time cleaning up and more time enjoying the moments that matter, and even the opportunity to take their fandom all the way to Super Bowl LXI.”


No matter what’s on the menu, Dawn and Cascade provide complete coverage for every dish in your kitchen. From greasy air fryer baskets to hard-to-clean mixers, Dawn tackles the items headed for the sink, while Cascade takes on the plates, bowls, pots, and pans headed for the dishwasher; no pre-rinse required. Together, they help fans clean the dishes faster and get back to the food, traditions and football that brought everyone together in the first place.
